criteria.criterion: Use only the official World Bank API response at the supplied URL (or clearly report if inaccessible)
Identify the latest year (2020–2026) where all three countries have non-null population values (or conclude none exists)
Report exact Population, total value for India in the latest common non-null year (full integer, no rounding)
Report exact Population, total value for Brazil in the latest common non-null year (full integer, no rounding)
Report exact Population, total value for Nigeria in the latest common non-null year (full integer, no rounding)
Rank countries from highest to lowest population for that year (or state ranking cannot be produced)
Stopping condition respected (stop after required outputs, or after establishing unavailability)
